# Ada & Hannah

- [Ada](../character/ada.md) — Sibling of — [Hannah](../character/hannah.md) — twin sister · since v3  <sub>[v3 ch.Farewell P19](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0019)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) bids a tearful farewell to her home at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and leaves for [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md). After a rainy drive to the station and a boat ride from [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown), she and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) travel by train to [Kingsport](../codex/places.md#kingsport). Upon arrival, [Anne](../character/anne.md) is warmly met by [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), who takes her by cab to their new boardinghouse while cheering her up.
>
> — v3 · Chapter III Greeting and Farewell
